nodes.label: Leveling (low/high/avg/median/spread)
nodes.contributor: Computed only over bidders WITH a bid; isLow on min leveledTotal; deltaFromLow = leveledTotal - low; outlier if >1.5x or <0.5x median when bidCount>=3

nodes.label: Award Recommendation Basis
nodes.contributor: Basis values: low leveled bid | single bid (no competition) | no bids received | already awarded. needsReview true unless already awarded; for low leveled bid needsReview = spreadPct>0.5

nodes.label: Risk Type Taxonomy
nodes.contributor: Auto-derived risk types: no_bids, single_bid, wide_spread, low_coverage, long_lead, past_due_no_award, draft_unpublished

nodes.label: Risk: no_bids (HIGH)
nodes.contributor: Package PUBLISHED with 0 bids

nodes.label: Risk: single_bid (MEDIUM)
nodes.contributor: Exactly 1 bid

nodes.label: Risk: wide_spread (MEDIUM)
nodes.contributor: bidCount>=3 and spreadPct>0.5

nodes.label: Risk: low_coverage (LOW)
nodes.contributor: bidCount/inviteCount < 0.25 and inviteCount>=4

nodes.label: Risk: long_lead (MEDIUM)
nodes.contributor: Keyword match: elevator, escalator, switchgear, generator, structural steel, curtain wall, glazing, HVAC equipment, chiller, transformer, millwork

nodes.label: Risk: past_due_no_award (MEDIUM)
nodes.contributor: bidsDueAt in the past (relative 2026-06-03) and no award

nodes.label: Risk: draft_unpublished (LOW)
nodes.contributor: Package state DRAFT

nodes.label: Project Phase Machine (pre-bid/bidding/leveling/awarding/post-award)
nodes.contributor: all DRAFT -> pre-bid; bidsDueAt future -> bidding; past with no awards -> leveling; some awards -> awarding; all awarded -> post-award

nodes.label: Project Status Indicator (green/yellow/red)
nodes.contributor: red if HIGH risk due within 7 days or past-due with 0 bids on key packages; yellow if upcoming deadline or open mediums; green otherwise
